# Endwise

> Endwise: exact answers for specific jobs, paid per use from one prepaid balance, on the web, over a REST API or through MCP.

Endwise is a Conyso product. Every tool is deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer, with no AI model in the loop. Each content page has a Markdown copy at the same address ending in .md.

## Using Endwise

- [Guides](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/): Every guide: using the tools from AI assistants, editors, spreadsheets and automations, building an agent, checking AI numbers, and paying per use.
- [How to use Endwise with Claude (Claude apps and Claude Code)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/use-with-claude/): Add Endwise as a custom connector, sign in and approve it with a monthly limit, try a first prompt, and keep spend under control.
- [How to use Endwise with ChatGPT](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/use-with-chatgpt/): Add Endwise to ChatGPT as a custom MCP server, sign in and approve it with a monthly limit, and call the same tools from the OpenAI API.
- [How to add Endwise to Cursor and VS Code (MCP)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/use-in-cursor-and-vs-code/): Exact mcp.json files for Cursor and VS Code with a Bearer key, how to keep keys out of git, and how to check it works.
- [Give your own AI agent exact tools: 3 ways](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/build-an-agent/): For developers: three ways to give an agent exact tools (Anthropic MCP connector, OpenAI remote MCP, REST function calling), with samples, per-agent keys, quotes and error handling.
- [Use Endwise in Google Sheets: custom functions with Apps Script](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/google-sheets/): Apps Script code for Sheets: custom functions, a menu command that writes values, the API key kept in script properties, and no double charges on recalculation.
- [Use Endwise in Excel with Power Query (POST with a JSON body)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/excel/): Power Query M code for Excel: a POST with a Bearer header and Json.FromValue body, a reusable function for table rows, and how to avoid paying again on refresh.
- [Use Endwise in Zapier, Make and n8n (one HTTP step)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/zapier-make-n8n/): One HTTP step in Zapier (Webhooks), Make (HTTP) and n8n (HTTP Request): URL, Authorization header, JSON body, result mapping and retry safety.
- [Why AI assistants get dates and numbers wrong](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/why-ai-gets-numbers-wrong/): Why language models miss on dates, holidays, rates and tax figures, shown with worked cases, and how to give an assistant a tool that gets them exactly.
- [How to check a number an AI gives you](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/check-numbers-from-ai/): A short procedure for checking a date, rate or tax figure from an AI assistant, with what to test for each kind of number.
- [Pay per use or a subscription: which costs less](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/pay-per-use-or-subscription/): The break-even formula for pay per use against a subscription, worked with Endwise prices: when per use wins and when a pass wins.
- [A spreadsheet or Endwise: which to use](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/guides/spreadsheet-or-endwise/): An honest comparison of a spreadsheet and Endwise for business days, exchange rates, mileage, per diem and 1099 thresholds, including when the spreadsheet wins.

## Tools

- [1099 threshold tracker](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/): Check which payees need a Form 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC for a payment year, in which box and why: the $2,000 line for 2026 payments, $600 for 2025, royalties at $10 and attorney gross proceeds at $600, with the corporation, card and merchandise exceptions, backup withholding, payees merged by TIN, due dates and an IRIS upload file.
- [Business days](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/): Count the business days between two dates, or add business days to a date, for US federal, England and Wales, or India central government holidays. US holidays are the statutory federal ones only, with no executive-order closures. India ("IN-CENTRAL-DELHI") is the closed (gazetted) holidays of central government offices in Delhi and New Delhi from the Department of Personnel and Training's yearly list, 2025 to 2027 only: not restricted holidays, not any state's list and not bank holidays. Add your own days off to skip them too.
- [Delivery date and holiday order-by calculator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/delivery-date-calculator/): Work out when an order arrives, or the last day to order for delivery by a date such as Christmas, from your cutoff time, time zone, shipping days, closures and processing days, on the carrier's own delivery calendar, with USPS's 2026 holiday send-by dates and every skipped holiday named.
- [Exchange rate on a date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/): The official rate for a currency pair on a date, with the date or period actually used. By default the ECB euro reference rate (the latest fixing in the 7 days up to the date, and which); or, with source, the US Treasury reporting rate, the IRS yearly average or the HMRC monthly rate, each named with the publication it came from.
- [IFTA quarterly return calculator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/ifta-calculator/): Work out an IFTA quarterly return per jurisdiction and fuel at the quarter's final matrix rates, surcharges included, from totals or from trip sheets and fuel receipts, with an odometer reconciliation across trips and a check of every record against the IFTA distance and fuel record elements.
- [Image to size](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/image-to-size/): Shrink a photo to fit under an exact size in KB, such as 50 KB or 200 KB, for upload forms that set a limit. It runs in your browser, so the photo never leaves your device.
- [MACRS depreciation schedule](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/macrs-depreciation/): Paste a client's fixed-asset additions for 2025 or 2026 and get the IRS percentage-table schedule: the mid-quarter 40% test across every asset with the worksheet, Section 179 within the year's limit and phase-out, the special allowance by acquisition date (100% after January 19, 2025), each number tied to its Publication 946 table, and the journal entry as a CSV.
- [Mileage reimbursement and IRS mileage log](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/mileage-reimbursement/): Price each trip at the IRS mileage rate in force on its date (2026: 72.5 cents to June 30, 76 cents from July 1; medical, moving, charity and GSA rates too), apply Announcement 2026-11's paid-date rule to employer allowances, total a payroll trip sheet per employee with the true-up owed and the W-2 split above the federal rate, and make an IRS-ready vehicle-year log with a Publication 463 completeness check.
- [QR code generator](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/qr-code-generator/): Static QR codes that never expire, for links, WiFi, contact cards, email, text messages, calls and map locations: every file is read back before you get it and shows the exact text it holds. Make a whole batch from a spreadsheet as a ZIP and a label sheet, and check whether a code you already printed goes through a vendor that can switch it off.
- [Tax set-aside per payment](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/tax-set-aside/): How much of one payment a self-employed person should set aside for tax, given what they have earned so far this year: US self-employment tax, federal brackets with the QBI deduction and state income tax, or UK Income Tax, Class 4 and student loan, split exactly where the payment crosses a bracket or threshold, with every constant cited.
- [Trucker per diem worksheet](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/): Turn an owner-operator's days on the road into the year's per diem deduction at the IRS transportation-industry rate in force each day ($80 since October 1, 2024; $69 and $66 before), with departure and return days at 3/4, the 80% hours-of-service limit, log checks and a worksheet for the preparer.

## Guides

- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to an LLC? (2026 rules)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/llc/): An LLC gets a 1099-NEC at $2,000 for 2026 services unless it is taxed as a corporation. Single-member, partnership and corporate LLCs worked out.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to a corporation? (2026)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/corporation/): Payments to corporations need no 1099, except legal fees, medical payments, attorney proceeds, substitute payments and cash for fish. 2026 cases.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to an S corporation? (2026)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/s-corp/): An S corporation, or an LLC taxed as one, gets no 1099 for most payments in 2026; legal fees and medical payments are the exceptions.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to an independent contractor?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/independent-contractor/): A contractor paid $2,000 or more in 2026 gets a Form 1099-NEC; $1,999.99 does not. Card payments, payment apps and backup withholding, worked out.
- [Do I need to issue a 1099 to my property management company?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/property-management-company/): Tenants send no 1099 for rent paid to a property manager. Owners do for management fees of $2,000 or more in 2026 to a non-corporate manager.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my attorney? (2026 rules)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/attorney/): Attorneys get a 1099 even when incorporated: 1099-NEC for fees of $2,000 or more in 2026, 1099-MISC box 10 for settlements and proceeds from $600.
- [Do I have to issue a 1099 to my cleaning lady?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/household-worker/): A 1099 is for business payments, so cleaning your own home needs none; a business that pays a cleaner $2,000 or more in 2026 files Form 1099-NEC. Worked cases.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my landlord? (2026: $2,000 rent)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/landlord/): A business paying $2,000 or more of rent in 2026 to a non-corporate landlord files 1099-MISC box 1. Rent via a manager, to a corporation or for your home: none.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my accountant or CPA?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/accountant-cpa/): Accountants and CPAs get a 1099-NEC for $2,000 or more of business fees in 2026, unless the firm is taxed as a corporation. Each kind of firm worked out.
- [Do I need to send a 1099 to my insurance company?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/1099-threshold/payee/insurance-company/): Premiums paid to an incorporated insurer need no 1099. Commissions of $2,000 or more in 2026 to an unincorporated agent go on Form 1099-NEC.
- [Count business days in Excel with NETWORKDAYS and holidays](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/excel-networkdays/): The exact Excel NETWORKDAYS formula for business days between two dates, with US and England and Wales holiday lists to paste.
- [Add business days to a date in Excel (WORKDAY, with holidays)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/excel-workday/): The exact Excel WORKDAY formula to add or subtract business days, with US and England and Wales holiday lists to paste.
- [Google Sheets NETWORKDAYS and WORKDAY, with holidays](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/google-sheets-networkdays/): Google Sheets formulas to count business days (NETWORKDAYS) and add them to a date (WORKDAY), with US and England and Wales holidays to paste.
- [Business days API: count and add business days over REST or MCP](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/api/): A REST and MCP API that counts or adds business days, skipping US or England and Wales holidays and naming each one. $0.0005 a call.
- [Add business days in Python with holidays (NumPy busday\_offset)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/business-days/python/): Add or count business days in Python with NumPy busday\_offset and busday\_count and a US federal holiday list, or call the API.
- [Christmas order deadline banner for Shopify and any store](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/delivery-date-calculator/christmas-order-deadline-banner/): How to add a Christmas order-by banner to any store, with deadlines from the store's own cutoff and USPS's 2026 send-by dates.
- [Historical exchange rates in Excel by date, from the ECB file](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/historical-exchange-rates-in-excel/): Look up an ECB rate for any date in Excel with one XLOOKUP, weekends and non-euro pairs included. EUR to USD on 31 December 2025 is 1.1750.
- [Which exchange rate to use for US taxes and the FBAR](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/which-exchange-rate-for-us-taxes/): Which exchange rate each US filing asks for: the spot rate for income and expenses, the IRS yearly averages, and the Treasury 31 December rate for the FBAR.
- [ECB exchange rate API: any date over REST and MCP](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/ecb-exchange-rate-api/): One POST returns the ECB rate for a pair on a date, the fixing actually used and the inverse, for $0.001 a call. AI agents get the same tool over MCP.
- [How an IFTA return is calculated, line by line](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/ifta-calculator/how-ifta-is-calculated/): The IFTA return method step by step, with a worked diesel example and surcharges.
- [IFTA record keeping: what a trip sheet and fuel receipt must show](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/ifta-calculator/record-keeping/): IFTA individual vehicle distance record and fuel receipt elements, retention and audit effects.
- [KB or KiB: is a kilobyte 1,000 or 1,024 bytes on an upload form?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/image-to-size/kb-or-kib/): Why KB can mean 1,000 or 1,024 bytes, with the byte counts for common upload limits under both readings.
- [IRS mileage log requirements 2026 (Pub 463)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/mileage-reimbursement/irs-mileage-log-requirements/): The IRS record elements for a mileage log (Pub 463 Table 5-1), when a log counts as timely, and a checker that lists missing elements.
- [Static vs dynamic QR codes: which ones expire](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/qr-code-generator/static-vs-dynamic/): The difference between static and dynamic QR codes, how to tell them apart, and vendors' published lapse policies with dates.
- [WiFi QR code format: the WIFI: text phones read](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/qr-code-generator/wifi-qr-code-format/): The WIFI: payload grammar phones scan, with escaping rules and worked examples.
- [vCard QR code format: contact cards phones save](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/qr-code-generator/vcard-qr-code-format/): The vCard 3.0 payload in a contact QR code, with escaping and size.
- [Owner-operator per diem deduction: Schedule C line 24b at 80%](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/owner-operator/): How an owner-operator figures and reports the per diem deduction on Schedule C, with the rest requirement and the 80% limit.
- [Per diem partial days: the 3/4 rule for departure and return days](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/partial-days/): How departure and return days are prorated at 3/4 of the transportation-industry rate, with the amount for every notice period.
- [Can company truck drivers claim per diem?](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/trucker-per-diem/company-drivers/): Why W-2 truck drivers cannot deduct per diem, and how much employer per diem is tax-free under an accountable plan.
- [Holiday calendars to subscribe to](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/calendars/): Free .ics holiday calendars you subscribe to once: US federal, England and Wales bank holidays, India central government.
- [Small business tax deadlines and calendar](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/deadlines/): The next US small business tax deadlines (1099, IFTA, estimated tax, Form 1040), moved for weekends and holidays, as a table and a free .ics calendar.
- [How to cite Endwise](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/cite/): How to cite a figure from a tool or table page: the address, the data date, the official source, with APA and MLA examples.
- [How the 1099 threshold is applied: method and sources](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/1099-threshold/): 1099 threshold tracker: How each payee is tested against the 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC lines for a payment year, and why a form is or is not needed.
- [How business days are counted: rules and sources](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/business-days/): Business days: How a business-day count or a date shifted by business days is worked out, and exactly which holidays are skipped.
- [How delivery dates are calculated: method and sources](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/delivery-date-calculator/): Delivery date and holiday order-by calculator: How an arrival date or a last-order date is worked out from a cutoff, processing days and the store and carrier calendars.
- [How exchange rates on a date are worked out: method](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/fx-on-date/): Exchange rate on a date: How an exchange rate for a date is cross-calculated from an official table, and what happens on days with no fixing.
- [How the IFTA return is calculated: Form 9740 method](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/ifta-calculator/): IFTA quarterly return calculator: How an IFTA quarterly return is worked out per jurisdiction and fuel, with Form 9740 rounding, surcharges, due dates and late cost.
- [How Image to size shrinks a photo to a KB limit](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/image-to-size/): Image to size: How a photo is shrunk to fit under an exact size in KB, entirely in your browser.
- [How MACRS depreciation is calculated: Publication 946](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/macrs-depreciation/): MACRS depreciation schedule: How a year's additions are run through the mid-quarter test, Section 179, the special allowance and the IRS percentage tables.
- [How mileage reimbursement is calculated: IRS rates](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/mileage-reimbursement/): Mileage reimbursement and IRS mileage log: How a trip is priced at the IRS or GSA mileage rate in force on its date, including mid-year changes and employer allowances.
- [How QR codes are generated: ISO/IEC 18004 method](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/qr-code-generator/): QR code generator: How text becomes a QR Code symbol: mode, version, error correction, mask choice, and the read-back check before a file is returned.
- [How the tax set-aside is calculated: marginal method](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/tax-set-aside/): Tax set-aside per payment: How the share of one payment to set aside for tax is found as the difference between two full-year tax runs.
- [How trucker per diem is calculated: IRS notices](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/trucker-per-diem/): Trucker per diem worksheet: How the IRS transportation-industry meals rate is applied day by day, with the partial-day and deduction-limit rules.
- [Endwise vs timeanddate.com for business days](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/compare/timeanddate/): Endwise business days beside the timeanddate.com Business Date Calculator, checked against timeanddate.com's help page and dated.
- [Endwise vs XE and OANDA for historical exchange rates](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/compare/xe-oanda/): Endwise exchange rate on a date beside the XE and OANDA historical rate tools, checked against their own sites and dated.
- [MileIQ and Everlance alternative: Endwise compared](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/compare/mileiq-everlance/): Endwise mileage reimbursement beside the MileIQ and Everlance mileage apps, checked against their own sites and dated.
- [TruckLogics IFTA alternative: Endwise IFTA calculator compared](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/compare/trucklogics/): Endwise IFTA calculator beside TruckLogics IFTA reporting, checked against the TruckLogics IFTA page and dated.
- [Endwise vs Track1099 for 1099 reporting lines](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/compare/track1099/): Track1099 files 1099s with the IRS and states; Endwise tells you which payees need one, from the IRS line.
- [QR Code Generator alternative: Endwise compared](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/compare/qr-code-generator/): QR Code Generator sells editable dynamic codes on paid plans; Endwise makes static codes that never expire.
- [TinyPNG alternative for a size in KB: Endwise compared](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/compare/tinypng/): TinyPNG compresses images in bulk and by API; Endwise fits a photo under the exact KB limit a form asks for, in your browser.
- [Keeper alternative for tax set-asides: Endwise compared](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/compare/keeper/): Keeper is a tax filing and bookkeeping service; Endwise works out how much of each payment to set aside, with every constant cited.
- [Fechas límite de impuestos para pequeños negocios](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/es/guias/calendario-de-impuestos-para-pequenas-empresas/): Las próximas fechas límite de impuestos para pequeños negocios en EE. UU. (1099, IFTA, impuestos estimados, Formulario 1040), trasladadas por fines de semana y feriados, en una tabla y un calendario .ics gratis.
- [Por qué la IA se equivoca con fechas y números](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/es/guias/por-que-la-ia-se-equivoca-con-los-numeros/): Por qué los modelos de lenguaje fallan en fechas, feriados, tipos de cambio y cifras de impuestos, con casos resueltos y cómo darle a un asistente una herramienta que los obtenga con exactitud.
- [Cómo verificar un número que le da una IA](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/es/guias/como-verificar-un-numero-de-la-ia/): Un procedimiento corto para verificar una fecha, un tipo de cambio o una cifra de impuestos de un asistente de IA, con qué probar en cada tipo de número.
- [Cómo usar Endwise con ChatGPT](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/es/guias/usar-endwise-con-chatgpt/): Agregue Endwise a ChatGPT como servidor MCP personalizado, inicie sesión y apruébelo con un límite mensual, y llame a las mismas herramientas desde la API de OpenAI.
- [Cómo usar Endwise con Claude (aplicaciones y Claude Code)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/es/guias/usar-endwise-con-claude/): Agregue Endwise como conector personalizado, inicie sesión y apruébelo con un límite mensual, pruebe una primera pregunta y mantenga el gasto bajo control.

- [ECB euro reference rates: the latest fixing for every currency](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/ecb-reference-rates/): The latest ECB euro reference rate for every currency it publishes, with the change from the fixing before and the weekdays with no fixing.
- [EUR to USD exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/eur-usd/): EUR to USD on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 1999.

- [GBP to INR exchange rate history: ECB reference rates by date](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/fx-on-date/gbp-inr/): GBP to INR on any date from the ECB reference rates: the latest fixing, month-end rates and yearly averages since 2009.
- [Reduce image size in KB: 20 KB to 1 MB, compared](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/image-to-size/reduce-image-size-in-kb/): How to reduce a photo to a size in KB, with what limits from 20 KB to 1 MB did to four test photos.
- [Sources and how we check the answers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/sources/): The official source, edition and read date behind each tool, and what its tests check the answers against.
- [Data updates](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/updates/): A dated log of changes to the data and rules behind the tools, newest first, each with its source.
- [Free widgets for your site: IRS rates, tax dates](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/widgets/): Free iframe widgets to paste into your site: IRS mileage and trucker per diem rates, the next IFTA due date, the 1099-NEC line, the next federal holiday and a business days counter.
- [Free data downloads](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/data/): Every table page that has a CSV copy, grouped by tool, with the page link, the CSV link and the data date.
- [Press kit](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/press/): Press kit: a one-sentence description, the maker, how it works, the logo, brand colors, how to write the name, and how to reach us.
- [2026 small business numbers: mileage, per diem, 1099, tax](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/small-business-numbers-2026/): Every current 2026 figure in the tools in one printable page: IRS mileage rates, trucker per diem, 1099 lines, Section 179, standard deduction, self-employment tax, estimated tax and IFTA dates.
- [IRS mileage rate history 2011 to 2026](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/irs-mileage-rate-history/): Every IRS standard mileage rate since 2011, business, medical or moving and charity, newest first, with the IRS source for each period.
- [Free spreadsheet templates for logs and records](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/templates/): Free .xlsx templates for a per diem log, an IFTA mileage and fuel log and a 1099 payee tracker, plus the mileage log template.
- [Prompt library](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/prompts/): Copy-paste prompts that make an assistant call a named Endwise tool and show its output, each with the exact answer the tool returns.
- [Our accuracy promise](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/accuracy-promise/): What happens when an answer is wrong or a call fails, as the refund policy and terms say, and how to report a wrong answer.
- [API changelog](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/developers/changelog/): Dated changes to the public REST API and MCP server, newest first.
- [Methodology: how each tool calculates its answers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/methodology/): For each tool, the rules it applies in order, the official source of each rule, the edge cases, the limits and the tests.
- [Compare Endwise with other tools](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/compare/): Endwise beside the tools people already use for the same jobs, checked against each tool's own site and dated.
- [Guías en español](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/es/guias/): Guías en español: calendario de fechas límite de impuestos, usar las herramientas desde Claude y ChatGPT, por qué la IA se equivoca con los números y cómo verificarlos.

## About

- [Tools](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/tools/): Every live tool by category, with what it does and its price per use in words.
- [Pricing](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/pricing/): Free use, passes for people, credit packs for code and agents, the team plan, every live tool's price in words, how a charge works, and common questions.
- [How it works](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/how-it-works/): Top up once, use any tool on the web, over REST or over MCP, and pay per use from one balance.
- [Developers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/developers/): The REST API: a quickstart with real requests and responses, API keys, errors, idempotency keys, rate limits, quotes and the OpenAPI document.
- [MCP for AI agents](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/developers/mcp/): Connect an AI agent over MCP: the server address, signing in or an API key, the tools it lists, quote\_price and example calls.
- [Why exact](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/why-exact/): Exact answers versus AI guesses, with worked examples from the tools: observed holidays, substitute days, weekend exchange rates and holiday delivery dates.
- [About](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/about/): Who makes the tools and how they work: Conyso Holdings, exact tools for specific jobs, no AI in the answers.
- [Who it's for](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/): The tools grouped by who uses them, with a page for each kind of work.
- [For freelancers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/freelancers/): For freelancers and the self-employed: tax set-aside per payment, an IRS mileage log, exchange rates on a date and business-day due dates.
- [For truckers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/truckers/): For owner-operator truckers: the year's per diem worksheet at the IRS transportation rate, and tax set-aside per settlement.
- [For bookkeepers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/bookkeepers/): For bookkeepers and tax preparers: 1099 thresholds with an IRIS file, payroll mileage at the IRS rate by date, per diem worksheets, set-aside and exchange rates.
- [For online sellers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/online-sellers/): For online sellers: delivery and holiday order-by dates, business-day handling times, photos under an upload size and exchange rates on a date.
- [For tax preparers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/tax-preparers/): For tax preparers and enrolled agents: per diem worksheets, mileage logs, 1099 scans and set-aside numbers to check and file from.
- [For gig drivers](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/gig-drivers/): For rideshare and delivery drivers: tax set-aside per payout with miles and tips, and miles at the IRS rate with a mileage log.
- [For real estate agents](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/real-estate-agents/): For real estate agents: tax set-aside per commission check, a mileage log at the IRS rate, and contract deadlines in business days.
- [For nonprofits](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/nonprofits/): For nonprofit treasurers and bookkeepers: mileage at the IRS business and charity rates, and 1099 scans with an IRIS file.
- [For payroll and HR](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/payroll-and-hr/): For payroll and HR: mileage reimbursement sheets at the IRS rate by date, and dates in business days.
- [For small business owners](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/small-business-owners/): For small business owners: 1099 scans for contractors with an IRIS file, and mileage at the IRS rate by date.
- [For landlords](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/for/landlords/): For landlords and property managers: security deposit deadlines and letters by state, 1099s for contractors, and mileage at the IRS rate.
- [Para conductores](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/es/para/conductores/): En español, para conductores de viajes y entregas: cuánto apartar para impuestos de cada pago, con millas y propinas, y las millas a la tarifa del IRS con un registro de millaje.
- [Status](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/status/): Each live tool's last check and 90 days of recorded checks, measured from inside the server.
- [Docs](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/docs): How to call the tools from code: REST and MCP, authentication, errors, idempotency and limits.
- [Privacy](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/privacy): What Endwise stores about visitors and accounts, in plain words.
- [Terms of service](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/terms/): The terms for using Endwise: accounts and keys, the prepaid balance, prices, refunds, acceptable use and liability.
- [Refunds and cancellation](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/refunds/): What Endwise refunds automatically, how to get unused money back, and how to close an account.
- [Acceptable use](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/acceptable-use/): What Endwise may not be used for.
- [Security](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/security/): How Endwise protects accounts, keys and balances, and how to report a vulnerability.
- [Contact](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/toll-preview/contact/): How to reach Endwise for support, billing, privacy and security.
